messages.subject: Calderdale House — EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Frances,

I'm pleased to confirm we have exchanged contracts this afternoon on the purchase of Calderdale House at £8,450,000, with completion fixed for 28 March 2025. The 10% deposit of £845,000 has been sent to Pemberton Rowe to hold as stakeholder. We'll now finalise the transfer, agree the completion statement and submit your VAT option to HMRC.

Congratulations — a good result.

Best,
Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
